text: You have returned all down feathers back to me! Most splendid.

speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: What? Of course not! It was an honour for you to serve Count Down.

speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: Is that you no longer serve a purpose here.

speaker: left
name: Count Down
text: I suggest you remove yourself from my presence imminently.

speaker: left

text: So that the game can end.
